messages:
Aisha (People Ops): FYI — Mike Chen (eng) resigned today. His last day will be Fri 2025-06-06. Need to coordinate benefits cutoff/COBRA, final pay, exit interview, equipment return, and access deprovision. @Sonia, can you confirm any blackout windows? @Luca / @IT-Bot / @Payroll-Bot tagging.

Sonia (Eng Manager): Thanks Aisha. We need full access through EOD on 6th for handoff. Can we deprovision at 2025-06-06 20:00 PDT? Also needs to run a quick knowledge transfer session Tue 6/3 10am.

Mike Chen (Eng): Confirmed — last week availability is flexible, will do KT Tue 10am and leave device at SF office if needed. Ty.

Luca (Security): Can do deprov schedule. Proposed: disable prod console tokens at 2025-06-06 17:00 UTC, block VPN at 20:00 PDT, keep email for 7 days for docs access. Any objections?

Sonia (Eng Manager): OK on tokens at 17:00 UTC. Keep email 7 days is helpful. Please ensure repo write access is removed at 17:05 UTC.

IT-Bot: Ticket IT-5492 created for laptop return and MDM wipe. Label/ship option: ship via FedEx prepaid or drop at SF office by 6/9. Link: https://redwood.corp/it/returns

Payroll-Bot: Payroll calc: final payout includes accrued PTO 42.5 hours + pro-rated bonus. COBRA/benefit offboard note: employer coverage ends 2025-06-30 (end of month). COBRA notification will be generated and emailed within 14 days after termination. Expected payment date: next payroll cycle after 6/6. I'll DM Aisha for SSN last4 verification.

Aisha (People Ops): I'll draft the COBRA packet and exit interview invite. Exit interview preferred window: week of 6/9. Mike, if you'd like remote or in-person? Also need to confirm direct deposit remains for final payout.

Mike Chen (Eng): Remote exit interview is fine. Direct deposit stays same.

Sonia (Eng Manager): One more ask — transfer ownership of oncall rotation and long-lived runbooks before EOD 6/6. I'll update schedules.

Luca (Security): Note: service account keys rotated 6/7 per policy if not transferred. I'll coordinate with eng leads to ensure no disruption.

Aisha (People Ops): Equipment return options sent. Final checklist for people ops: 1) COBRA packet sent 2) Payroll calc 3) Exit interview scheduled 4) IT ticket closed 5) Access deprov schedule confirmed 6) Equipment receipt. Will follow up tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:

Sonia (Eng Manager): Thanks — appreciate the clear checklist. :thumbsup:

Mike Chen (Eng): Thanks everyone for making this smooth.
